props.name: active
props.description: True from the moment navigation starts until it finishes. Going false completes the bar and fades it out.

props.name: value
props.description: Real progress, 0–100, when the router knows it. Omit to let the bar trickle on its own.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the progress bar.

props.name: position
props.description: `fixed` pins it to the top of the viewport; `absolute` to the top of the nearest positioned ancestor.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds before a short navigation shows the bar at all.
